## Keyboard shortcuts

- Add a Keyboard Shortcuts screen (View menu, the command palette, or Ctrl+Shift+/) that lists every shortcut by category and can be searched by name or key.
- Tabs: Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab to cycle, Ctrl+1 to Ctrl+8 and Ctrl+9 to jump, Ctrl+Shift+W to close, Ctrl+Shift+D to clone, Ctrl+Shift+R to reconnect or restart, and Ctrl+Shift+PgUp/PgDn to move a tab.
- Split view: Ctrl+Shift+- to split down, and Alt+Arrow to move between groups while the window is split.
- Window: Ctrl+Shift+N for a new window, Ctrl+, for Settings, Ctrl+Shift+B to show or hide the sessions pane, and F11 for full screen.
- Terminal: per-tab zoom (Ctrl+=, Ctrl+-, Ctrl+0 or Ctrl+mouse wheel), Select All, Clear Scrollback, page and top/bottom scrolling, and Ctrl+Insert / Shift+Insert to copy and paste.
- Session tree: F2 renames a folder or edits a session, and Delete deletes the selection after asking.
- Plain Ctrl+letter and Alt+letter keys always reach the shell, so Ctrl+W, Ctrl+R and the tmux prefix keep working.

## Remote programs and Claude Code

- Remote programs such as Claude Code, tmux and Neovim can copy to the Windows clipboard with OSC 52. A remote host can never read the clipboard.
- Shift+Enter inserts a newline in Claude Code and similar prompts instead of submitting.
- Emoji and wide symbols take the same width as on the remote host, so full-screen programs stay aligned with the cursor.
- OSC 8 hyperlinks open in the browser, and hovering one shows its real target.
- Resesh answers terminal version queries and asks SSH servers for truecolor, so Claude Code and other tools use synchronized output and full colour.

## Progress

- Show progress reported by programs (OSC 9;4) and by file-pane transfers as a bar on the tab and on the taskbar button.

## Fixes and polish

- Fix GPU-rendered terminal text that was sometimes blurry at fractional display scaling until the window was resized.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.
